description:
Starts a Tennessee auto and/or home insurance quote that compares multiple carriers, and sends the shopper a 6 digit verification code.

    Requires that check_eligibility returned eligible and that the shopper read the consent text
    and agreed: consent_accepted must be true and consent_version must be the version
    check_eligibility returned. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. desired_start_date is when the new policy
    should begin (default about 18 days out; carriers quote up to 45 days ahead). verify_by is how
    the code is sent. assistant_name is the name of the calling assistant, used for attribution only.
    Returns a quote_id for every later call and the list of details still missing.
name: start_quote
title: Start a quote
